---
title: Dashboard
---

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
demo_2021_2023 <- read_xpt("DEMO_L.XPT")
glimpse(demo_2021_2023)

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  nhanesA,    # Access official NHANES data
  tidyverse,  # Data cleaning and manipulation
  janitor,    # Clean variable names
  mice,       # Single imputation for missing values (Study 2)
  rsample     # Train/Test data splitting (Study 2)
)

set.seed(431) # Set seed for reproducibility

# Demographics data (DEMO)
demo_raw <- nhanes("P_DEMO") %>%
  select(SEQN, RIDSTATR, RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR, RIDRETH3, INDHHIN2, DMDEDUC2)

# Body measures data (BMX)
bmx_raw <- nhanes("P_BMX") %>%
  select(SEQN, BMXBMI, BMXHT, BMXWT, BMXWAIST)

# Blood pressure data (BPXO)
bpx_raw <- nhanes("P_BPXO") %>%
  select(SEQN, BPXOSY1, BPXODI1)

# Laboratory data (GHB & GLU)
ghb_raw <- nhanes("P_GHB") %>% select(SEQN, LBXGH)  # Glycohemoglobin (HbA1c)
glu_raw <- nhanes("P_GLU") %>% select(SEQN, LBXGLU) # Fasting Glucose

raw_merged <- demo_raw %>%
  left_join(bmx_raw, by = "SEQN") %>%
  left_join(bpx_raw, by = "SEQN") %>%
  left_join(ghb_raw, by = "SEQN") %>%
  left_join(glu_raw, by = "SEQN")

data_processed <- raw_merged %>%
  # Filter 1: Mandatory check for examined subjects (RIDSTATR == 2)
  filter(RIDSTATR == 2) %>%
  
  # Filter 2: Retain adult population only (Age 20 and over)
  filter(RIDAGEYR >= 20) %>%
  
  mutate(
    # Biological sex (1 = Male, 2 = Female)
    sex = factor(case_when(
      RIAGENDR == 1 ~ "Male",
      RIAGENDR == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )),
    
    # Race/Ethnicity (6 categories using RIDRETH3)
    race_eth = factor(case_when(
      RIDRETH3 == 1 ~ "Mexican American",
      RIDRETH3 == 2 ~ "Other Hispanic",
      RIDRETH3 == 3 ~ "Non-Hispanic White",
      RIDRETH3 == 4 ~ "Non-Hispanic Black",
      RIDRETH3 == 6 ~ "Non-Hispanic Asian",
      RIDRETH3 == 7 ~ "Other/Multi-Racial",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )),
    
    # Household income collapsed into 4 categories per project specifications
    income_4cat = factor(case_when(
      INDHHIN2 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 13) ~ "Lowest (<20k)",
      INDHHIN2 %in% c(5, 6, 7)         ~ "Low (20k-44.9k)",
      INDHHIN2 %in% c(8, 9, 10)        ~ "High (45k-74.9k)",
      INDHHIN2 %in% c(14, 15)          ~ "Highest (>=75k)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ # Codes 77, 99, and missing are set to NA
    ), levels = c("Lowest (<20k)", "Low (20k-44.9k)", "High (45k-74.9k)", "Highest (>=75k)")),
    
    # Educational attainment for adults (20+)
    education = factor(case_when(
      DMDEDUC2 %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Less than HS",
      DMDEDUC2 == 3         ~ "HS Grad",
      DMDEDUC2 == 4         ~ "Some College",
      DMDEDUC2 == 5         ~ "College Grad",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Less than HS", "HS Grad", "Some College", "College Grad")),
    
    # Rename/recode quantitative variables
    age = RIDAGEYR,
    bmi = BMXBMI,
    waist = BMXWAIST,
    sys_bp = BPXOSY1,
    dia_bp = BPXODI1,
    hba1c = LBXGH,
    fpg = LBXGLU
  ) %>%
  
  # Drop unused factor levels
  droplevels() %>%
  
  # Select final analytic variables
  select(
    SEQN, RIDSTATR, age, sex, race_eth, income_4cat, education,
    bmi, waist, sys_bp, dia_bp, hba1c, fpg
  )
study1_df <- data_processed %>%
  drop_na() # Remove any rows with missing values

# Verify sample size (Must be between 500 and 7,500)
cat("Study 1 Sample Size:", nrow(study1_df), "\n")
write_csv(study1_df, "study1_clean.csv")

study2_base <- data_processed %>%
  filter(!is.na(hba1c) & !is.na(bmi)) # Complete cases on Outcome & Key Predictor only

# Single imputation using MICE (m = 1) for remaining covariates
mice_out <- mice(study2_base, m = 1, method = "pmm", printFlag = FALSE)
study2_imputed <- complete(mice_out)

cat("Study 2 Imputed Dataset Sample Size:", nrow(study2_imputed), "\n")

# Partition dataset: 70% Training (Development), 30% Testing (Validation)
split_obj <- initial_split(study2_imputed, prop = 0.70)
study2_train <- training(split_obj)
study2_test  <- testing(split_obj)

cat("Study 2 Training Set Sample Size:", nrow(study2_train), "\n")
cat("Study 2 Testing Set Sample Size:", nrow(study2_test), "\n")

# Export datasets
write_csv(study2_train, "study2_train.csv")
write_csv(study2_test, "study2_test.csv")

```
